en: Oh, sorry! I was just looking for someone. He comes to these sorts of places a lot.
Oh, that's not right. A young girl like you shouldn't be hanging around a man like that.
For instance, there's this one strange man who comes by, still dressed in his taxi driver's uniform. You wouldn't want to run into someone like that, would you?
I'm good for now.
Okay. Come back anytime!
Guess I wanna hit up a cabaret club. I could use drinkin' and conversation.
Ah, then I know just the place. I highly recommend Rose Hip!
What sorta place is it?
It's over on Lavender Street. The interior is a little on the dark side, and the seating areas are all partitioned off from one another.
It's perfectly suited for spending quality one-on-one time.
Let's go then.
Sir, you appear to have some company with you already.
Ah, yeah, that's right. Sorry 'bout that. I'll come back later.
Hello, this is Arai from Tsukimino Guide.
(Damn. Ain't got the cash.)
Hold that thought. I gotta come back later.
Makes sense. Guys who get out more got a lot more stuff to talk about.
Ya mean like orderin' more pricey drinks?
No one likes a cheapskate, huh.
So if you're good at talkin', ya don't need to spend as much money. That it?
Yeah, I hear ya.
S'pose that's true.
Alright. You've been a lotta help. Thanks.
But askin' a girl out doesn't mean she's always gonna say yes.
So it's all about timin'.
Okay, wait, I have something! Once you've talked your hostess up as much as you can, you normally wouldn't need to order anything else for the remainder of your time.
Whaddya mean by "a different sorta hospitality"?
That sorta does sound appealin'.
Very well. Ya really know yer clubs.
I'm good for right now, actually.

Welcome!
Ah! Little girl, what are you doing in a place like this?
Oh, sorry! I don't need anything! I'll just be on my way.
Yeah, do that. Maybe come back when you're older, yeah?
I'd like to go to a cabaret club. Know any good ones?
There's always Prime, of course.
Yeah, that sounds familiar.
Prime is in Shofukucho. It's the premier club in Sotenbori.
Lead the way, my friend.
Oh, right. Sorry. I'll be back later.
Understood, sir.
Hello, this is Nakamoto from Infomen.
All right, if you'll please follow me.
(Damn. I don't have enough money.)
On second thought, I actually need to come back later.
Well, come back soon!
I'll pass for now.
Right. People who get out often are going to have more things to talk about.
You mean ordering more expensive drinks?
Being cheap isn't an attractive quality.
That means if you're a savvy talker, you won't need to spend as much money.
Thanks. I get you.
That's definitely something to keep in mind.
That's good advice. You've been very helpful. Thank you.
Still, asking a girl out doesn't guarantee that she'll say yes.
Right. Timing is important.
A different sort of hospitality?
That does sounds intriguing.
Oh, hey! How was the club?
As good as you said it was. It really might be the best in all of Osaka.

Welcome!
...Wait, Haruka Sawamura-chan!? Is that really you?

Whoa, it is you! Okay, keep cool, man.
...Should I get her autograph?
Welcome! What sort of girl are you looking for today, sir?
Hm. I think I'd like someone who's still kinda new.
Ah, a true connoisseur! Someone new and exciting coming right up!
Okay, the two newest ones are Momoe-chan from Resort Boing, and Noriko-chan from Boom and Bust.
I got two choices, huh? Okay, tell me about them both.
Momoe-chan's 29 years old, with a hefty pair of Ds! She's got that real erotic mix of adult sultriness, along with a fresh-faced newbie appeal.
Hmmm. Okay, and what about Noriko-chan?
Noriko-chan is 25, and's a real perky little gal. She's got B-cups, along with a fit body that makes all the guys in Kineicho drool.
They sure do sound different, that's for sure. I wonder which one Uno-san would go for.
If he likes new girls, wouldn't he go for the younger one?
There is that, but he's a pretty twisted guy. An older girl who's new to the job might be just the kind of thing that'll get him going.
Right... Anyway, my vote's for Noriko.

Yeah, I'm still not so sure.
Oh, so mind telling me where these two places are?
Momoe-chan is at Resort Boing, at the south end of Tsumugi Street.
Noriko-chan's at Boom and Bust, north on Kumano Boulevard.
Thanks. Now, which one should I go to?
Welcome! Oh, hey, Shinada-san. What are you doing here?
Oh, ah, no, it's nothing! Nothing at all! I'll see you later!
(I don't have time to fool around today.)
Welcome! Oh, hey, Shinada. What are you doing here?
Well, I haven't been to a cabaret club in a while. What's good nowadays?
Oh, Club Eden is where it's at, hands down.
The one over on Kumano Boulevard? I haven't been there in a while.
I can imagine. The place is so gorgeous, I'm not sure you're really suited for it.
Let's head over!
Um, Shinada-san, your friend looks rather a bit... concerned.
Oh, yes, right! Sorry about that. I'll be back later.
You sure? You know you can't put this on a tab, right?
It's fine, honest!
Okay, okay. I'll check with the club now. Give me a moment.
Hi, this is Takagi from MayNavi.
Yes, well, I have a guest here who'd like to stop by.
Hey, hold on. I'll have to come back later!
I knew you were broke! Please, don't keep doing this to me.
I'll be back. For real this time!
Sure, thanks, buddy.
Hey, don't just take everything I say and put it in your magazine, okay?
Ah, okay. Yeah, guys who've been around have a lot more to talk about.
Like ordering more expensive drinks?
So basically if you're cheap, you're a scumbag.
Usually, yes. It is important to be able to get a hostess the very best drink you can.
But if you're good at holding a conversation, you won't need to spend all that money, right?
Thanks. I got the gist.
Hey, that is good to know. At this point, I'm happy to save even a single yen!
But asking a girl out doesn't mean she'll definitely say yes, right?
Got it. So timing is important.
I'll try to remember that.
Huh? What's that mean?
Aww yeah, that sounds nice!
Ah, Shinada-san. Did things go okay over at Club Eden?
Oh, it went more than okay! In fact, I'm probably gonna be going there an awful lot from now on!
Just remember they won't run a tab, so be careful.
What else can I help you with today?
I'm okay for now, thanks.

Welcome!
Wait, what... Ah! What are you doing here!?
Sheesh, I almost had a panic attack! I'd get arrested if I tried to take you to a club.
Can you find me a cabaret club?
I thought that might be it! In that case, allow me to recommend Elise!
It's on Taihei Boulevard, in front of the Millennium Tower. It's the biggest in Kamurocho⑬very popular, and lots of pretty girls!
Lead the way.
Ah, right, of course. Sorry about that. I'll come back later.
Oh, right, I should probably mention... They're undergoing a kind of, ah, revamp right now.
Hm? What's that mean?
Sorry. What I mean to say is that Elise is currently in a rebuilding phase, in order to improve the quality of their service.
The girls currently seem to be rotating out on a daily basis, so we can't make any real guarantees on your experience.
I actually know the owner. Now that you mention it, I recall him saying something about looking for girls who are ready for prime time.
Really? I know the owner, Akiyama, but this is news to me.
Yes, well, it might be better not to go until you get an invitation from the owner himself.
Yeah, that's probably true. I'll wait until I hear from Akiyama then.
If you like, I can find you another club.
That's okay. I'll just wait until Elise is a little further along in its rebuilding process.
Very well. Well, please do come again soon!
(Elise will be done with this rebuilding once they have strong girls from around the country. I should wait until then before I go there.)
(Elise is rebuilding its business? What could Akiyama be up to?)
Hello? This is Shimura, over at MEB.
I have a gentleman here who's looking to patronize your establishment.
I'm good for right now.
Oh! How did things go?
You remember me?
Of course I do! And I hope I'll be able to be of service to you again.
Now, what can I do for you today?
Welcome! Can I help you find something today?
I'm okay for now. Thank you.
Nah, I'm good for now. Thanks.

Welcome!
Oh, I'm terribly sorry. We don't provide recommendations for host clubs, young lady.
What? Oh, no, I'm sorry! I'll go someplace else!
Haha, sounds like this is your first time!
Yo, Ta-chan! You been to see any ball games lately?
These days I just watch them on TV⑬I can't afford to buy actual tickets. Why do you ask?
'Cause I got me some tickets to a VIP skybox! I can hardly wait for game day!
A VIP skybox? Don't you have to reserve those with like, a year-long contract?
Since they are normally used by companies for entertainment purposes, normal spectators don't get to experience them too often.
Well, I can't wait! Getting to look out over the field in a private room, while kicking back on a sofa to watch the game? That's luxury for ya!
I don't know, I'd rather be sitting right behind home plate instead of watching from so far away.
That's why they've got monitors! You can get a play-by-play view right in the skybox!
And they've even got room service, so it's got watching at home beat, hands down.
(VIP skyboxes at baseball games. Maybe I could talk about that at the cabaret club.)
Oh, Kiryu-san!
Hey, who's that ya got with you?
Oh, uh...
If y'got something to do, you oughta go finish that up first.
Yes, you're right.
That's all right, I wanted to see ya! There's some stuff I wanted to talk about. Let's just wander about 'round here!
Okay, shall we get going?
Ain't the view from here the absolute best?
People do rave about this view of Nagasugai from the Ose Bridge.
I do really like this bridge. Whenever I have some time before work, I come here.
You come here just for the view?
Sometimes I'll ride the water bus. It's a great way to pass the time.

Ah. I haven't gotten around to riding that yet.
Maybe I should try it soon.
It's nice t'see something familiar from a distance sometimes.
Speaking of, the tower's nearby, isn't it? I'd like to get a look at Nagasugai from high up above at some point, too.
Next time we should go do that!
That guy over there! That's that Subaru-san I was telling y'bout earlier!
Subaru? You mean the guy that was scamming your friends?
Mm. They texted me pics. I know that's him!
Riku, wait up!
Are you Subaru-san!?
Yeah. And who the heck are you?
You're two-timin' Yuka-chan and Asumi-chan, aren't ya? And a whole lotta other girls, I'd reckon!
Ah, so y'know those girls, huh? I'm not two-timing anyone. I'm a host. Lotsa ladies ask for me, it's my job.
Don't y'dare play dumb! You were talking to them about gettin' married!
So what if I did?
You're trickin' girls in order to milk them outta all their money! Then y'can go and sell 'em right off to the sex trade, right!?
Hahaha. What are y'talking about? Who told ya that nonsense?
Who told me?
Y'know, sometimes rival hosts start bullshit rumors to ruin my rep. So who was it? Ya boyfriend or someone?
It ain't like that!

Sorry, but I ain't got time t'deal with your drama right now, missy.
Later.
Sorry 'bout that. I shouldn't have done that in the middle of our date.
It's okay.
Anyhow, I oughta head home now. See ya later!
Hey, Saejima-san!
Hey. Sorry to keep ya waitin'.
Oh? Is there someone with you?
If you have something to do, please go and take care of that first. I'll be waiting for you here.
Sorry. I'll get it done.
It's okay, I wanted to see you! I just wanted to talk with you some more. Let's go wander around here for a bit.
All right, let's go.
This park's nice. I like bein' able to get such a good view in the middle of a big city. Ya can even see the mountains.
Hokkaido has plenty of natural scenery! The university campus is especially great for taking walks.
That so? If I had more time, it woulda been nice to take a walk over there.
You like Hokkaido, don't you, Saejima-san?
Yeah. I never get tired of lookin' at the nature here.
I'm embarrassed to once've been proud of some tiny little man-made neighborhood crammed in the corner of Tokyo.
A real man should stand up to nature, and then overcome it.
I do have to admit that living in a place like this really suits me.
Like the story of the ants and the grasshopper, we work in the cool summers and stay holed up nice and cozy in the cold winters.
